title: 尼克斯与游骑兵分拆：麦迪逊广场花园体育公司价值重估
speaker: Randall Williams

segments.en: Randall and I, we were at the New York Knicks Parade, so we did that together.
segments.zh: 兰德尔和我一起参加了纽约尼克斯队的游行，我们共同经历了那件事。

segments.en: We had a great time out there. But now all this, the Knicks moving closer to this New York Ranger spin-off, I mean, what's going on? Is this going through?
segments.zh: 我们在那里玩得很开心。但现在，尼克斯队与纽约游骑兵队分拆的计划越来越近，到底怎么回事？能成吗？

segments.en: I think so. I think the Knicks or Madison Square Garden Sports Corporation is targeting separating the Rangers business from the Knicks business.
segments.zh: 我觉得能成。尼克斯队，或者说麦迪逊广场花园体育公司，正计划将游骑兵队的业务从尼克斯队的业务中分离出来。

segments.en: And so what this will mean is that Madison Square Garden Sports Corporation will become the Madison Square Garden Knicks Corporation, and then there will be a separate Rangers business.
segments.zh: 这意味着麦迪逊广场花园体育公司将更名为麦迪逊广场花园尼克斯公司，而游骑兵队将成为独立的业务。

segments.en: What's expected to happen is this is going to extract value. This is going to figure out the difference between the Knicks business and the Rangers business.
segments.zh: 预计这将释放价值，厘清尼克斯业务与游骑兵业务之间的差异。

segments.en: And James Dolan has said that he has no plans of selling either team.
segments.zh: 詹姆斯·多兰表示，他没有出售任何一支球队的计划。

segments.en: But once you see the value of those teams, who's to say he couldn't get $2 billion for 20% of the team, or maybe even 15% of the team?
segments.zh: 但一旦这些球队的价值显现，谁能说他不能以20%的股份获得20亿美元，甚至15%的股份呢？
